none: PAS DENO-69EA57: Roman coin: probable contemporary copy of a radiate of Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: Northamptonshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy probable contempary copy (Barbarous radiate) of a radiate of Divus Claudius (the deified Claudius II after AD 270), dating to the period AD 275-285 (Reece Period 14). Probably CONSECRATIO reverse type depicting altar. Probably copying mint of Rome. The coin is very small and is very worn but traces of legend can be seen, probably CONSECRATIO, or a garbled version
